verdict.rationale: CT Corporation is a registered-agent and compliance service, so scanning state mail and legal documents into an online account is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing the site is walled behind a Cloudflare challenge. No content documents scanning, online viewing, downloading, or sharing of documents, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, state mail and legal documents are scanned into an online account where I can read, download, and share them
